units.source_text: 天气渐凉，明石皇后打算回宫中去。

en.t: As the weather gradually grew cooler, Empress Akashi planned to return to the palace.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女都觉得可惜，聚集在皇后殿前央请：

en.t: The young gentlewomen all felt it was a pity, and gathered before the Empress's residence to plead with her:

units.source_text: “秋色方盛，这里的红叶正美，难道不看么？”

en.t: "Autumn is just at its height, and the maple leaves here are at their loveliest. Will you really leave without seeing them?"

units.source_text: 于是天天临水赏月，管弦之会不绝，比往常更热闹了。

en.t: So every day they admired the moon by the water, and musical gatherings went on without pause, making things livelier than usual.

units.source_text: 匂亲王最擅长音乐，常常参与演奏。

en.t: Prince Niou was especially skilled in music, and often joined in the performances.

units.source_text: 此人虽然朝夕见惯，但其容貌之昳丽，常像初开的花。

en.t: Although they were used to seeing him morning and evening, the beauty of his face always seemed like a newly opened flower.

units.source_text: 薰大将则不常来此，众侍女都觉得此人仪表威严，难于接近。

en.t: General Kaoru, by contrast, did not often come there, and the gentlewomen all found him imposing in manner and difficult to approach.

units.source_text: 这两人同来参见皇后之时，侍从从屏后窥见了，想道：

en.t: When the two men came together to pay their respects to the Empress, Jiju glimpsed them from behind a screen and thought:

units.source_text: “这两个人，都是我家小姐所爱慕的。

en.t: "These two men were both beloved by my young lady.

units.source_text: 小姐倘能活在世间，享受福报，多么好呢！

en.t: How wonderful it would have been if she could have lived in this world and enjoyed such happiness!

units.source_text: 顿萌短见，其心实在太怯弱了。”

en.t: For her to have suddenly formed such a desperate resolve, her heart was truly far too fragile."

units.source_text: 她对人装作不知道宇治那边的事情，绝不谈起，只在自己心里痛惜。

en.t: To others she pretended to know nothing about the affairs at Uji, never speaking of them, and only grieved over them in her own heart.

units.source_text: 匂亲王向母后详细禀告宫中之事，薰大将便告辞而出。

en.t: Prince Niou reported the affairs of the palace to his mother in detail, while General Kaoru took his leave and withdrew.
"I must not let him see me.

units.source_text: 未过小姐周年忌辰我就出来，深恐他怨我无情。”

en.t: If I appear before my lady's first memorial day has passed, I fear he will deeply resent me for being heartless."
And so she hid herself away.
